get.description:
What a person needs to connect an application, in one read: where to send decisions and how far shadow is.

`shadow` is present while the company is in SHADOW or PILOT: the decisions seen so far against what the plan needs,
each as a plain ratio, and `ready` when every shadow gate passes. Nothing here is a secret.

post.description:
Read a certificate picture and compare it with the claim, WITHOUT saving it. The file is scanned for malware, read in memory for this one answer and dropped: nothing is stored, so it needs no
place in the company's data region. It is the same check an upload gets (`read`), offered before the person decides to add the document. Evidence only: it never verifies the company.

post.description:
The claim is VERIFIED (all four checks complete): create the organization from it, name the workspace after the register and activate the claimant as
owner. Refused with CLAIM_NOT_VERIFIED until then. A repeat answers as it stands (13B hands off to 13C; nothing here grants authority a check has not).

get.description:
The status carries an ETag of exactly what it says, and is never cached by anyone: a person polling it sends the tag back and
gets a bare 304 while nothing has changed.

schema.title: Claim Id

post.description:
The applicant says the claim is complete. It is accepted for review (202), not decided: the checks are the same checks, and nothing
here makes the company verified. The claim must say whom to screen and how the person acts for the company first. Once: a repeat is
the same answer and changes nothing.

schema.title: Claim Id
Response Submit Claim V1 Org Claims  Claim Id  Submit Post

post.description:
The applicant withdraws a claim. Nothing is deleted; nobody is watched for it any more; the applicant may start a new claim. A
claim that is verified is not withdrawn here (that is a governed change), and a repeat is the same answer.
